expires.description: Expires is when this resource expires (RFC3339).

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs attached to the resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the resource namespace (usually left blank).

revision.description: Revision is used for optimistic concurrency control.

spec.description: App resource definition v3 from Teleport

UserGroups.description: UserGroups are a list of user group IDs that this app is associated with.

aws.description: AWS contains additional options for AWS applications.

external_id.description: ExternalID is the AWS External ID used when assuming roles in this app.

roles_anywhere_profile.description: RolesAnywhereProfile contains the IAM Roles Anywhere fields associated with this Application. These fields are set when performing the synchronization of AWS IAM Roles Anywhere Profiles into Teleport Apps.

accept_role_session_name.description: Whether this Roles Anywhere Profile accepts a custom role session name. When not supported, the AWS Session Name will be the X.509 certificate's serial number. When supported, the AWS Session Name will be the identity's username. This value comes from: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rolesanywhere/latest/APIReference/API_ProfileDetail.html / acceptRoleSessionName

profile_arn.description: ProfileARN is the AWS IAM Roles Anywhere Profile ARN that originated this Teleport App.

cloud.description: Cloud identifies the cloud instance the app represents.

cors.description: CORSPolicy defines the Cross-Origin Resource Sharing settings for the app.

allow_credentials.description: allow_credentials indicates whether credentials are allowed.

allowed_headers.description: allowed_headers specifies which headers can be used when accessing the app.

allowed_methods.description: allowed_methods specifies which methods are allowed when accessing the app.

allowed_origins.description: allowed_origins specifies which origins are allowed to access the app.

exposed_headers.description: exposed_headers indicates which headers are made available to scripts via the browser.

max_age.description: max_age indicates how long (in seconds) the results of a preflight request can be cached.

dynamic_labels.description: DynamicLabels are the app's command labels.

command.description: Command is a command to run

period.description: Period is a time between command runs

identity_center.description: IdentityCenter encapsulates information specific to AWS IAM Identity Center. Only valid for Identity Center account apps.

account_id.description: Account ID is the AWS-assigned ID of the account

permission_sets.description: PermissionSets lists the available permission sets on the given account

arn.description: ARN is the fully-formed ARN of the Permission Set.

assignment_name.description: AssignmentID is the ID of the Teleport Account Assignment resource that represents this permission being assigned on the enclosing Account.

name.description: Name is the human-readable name of the Permission Set.

insecure_skip_verify.description: InsecureSkipVerify disables app's TLS certificate verification.

integration.description: Integration is the integration name that must be used to access this Application. Only applicable to AWS App Access. If present, the Application must use the Integration's credentials instead of ambient credentials to access Cloud APIs.

mcp.description: MCP contains MCP server related configurations.

args.description: Args to execute with the command.

command.description: Command to launch stdio-based MCP servers.

run_as_host_user.description: RunAsHostUser is the host user account under which the command will be executed. Required for stdio-based MCP servers.

public_addr.description: PublicAddr is the public address the application is accessible at.

required_app_names.description: RequiredAppNames is a list of app names that are required for this app to function. Any app listed here will be part of the authentication redirect flow and authenticate alongside this app.

rewrite.description: Rewrite is a list of rewriting rules to apply to requests and responses.

headers.description: Headers is a list of headers to inject when passing the request over to the application.

name.description: Name is the http header name.

value.description: Value is the http header value.

jwt_claims.description: JWTClaims configures whether roles/traits are included in the JWT token.

redirect.description: Redirect defines a list of hosts which will be rewritten to the public address of the application if they occur in the "Location" header.

tcp_ports.description: TCPPorts is a list of ports and port ranges that an app agent can forward connections to. Only applicable to TCP App Access. If this field is not empty, URI is expected to contain no port number and start with the tcp protocol.

end_port.description: EndPort describes the end of the range, inclusive. If set, it must be between 2 and 65535 and be greater than Port when describing a port range. When omitted or set to zero, it signifies that the port range defines a single port.

port.description: Port describes the start of the range. It must be between 1 and 65535.

uri.description: URI is the web app endpoint.

use_any_proxy_public_addr.description: UseAnyProxyPublicAddr will rebuild this app's fqdn based on the proxy public addr that the request originated from. This should be true if your proxy has multiple proxy public addrs and you want the app to be accessible from any of them. If `public_addr` is explicitly set in the app spec, setting this value to true will overwrite that public address in the web UI.
